description: legion hooks — VALIDATED AGAINST CLAUDE CODE 2.1.219 (binary ~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.219). Shape: plugin hooks live at hooks/hooks.json (auto-discovered; plugin.json declares no `hooks` path, because declaring one DISABLES the default folder) in the wrapper form {description?, hooks:{Event:[{matcher?, hooks:[...]}]}}. EXEC FORM, not shell: `args` is present on every entry, and per that build's own schema text 'When present, `command` is resolved as an executable and spawned directly with these arguments - no shell. Path placeholders like ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} are substituted per-element as plain strings'. MATCHERS, per the dispatcher's event->field switch: SessionStart matches `source`, SubagentStop matches `agent_type`, Notification matches `notification_type`; a matcher of ^[a-zA-Z0-9_|]+$ is split on | and compared as EXACT STRINGS, anything else is compiled as a RegExp. EXACTLY THREE EVENTS, and NO GLOBAL Stop HOOK (PLAN-V3 §Gates: it would interfere with the approval and orchestration stages — that rule stands unchanged). A PreToolUse entry (T26's Bash remote-write guard) existed until 2026-08-07 and was REMOVED together with the pre-push git hook, by owner decision: server-side branch protection (verified by `legion doctor`) is the only remote-write barrier, and a developer is free to push and open MRs by hand — `legion finalize` remains the intended path for feature branches, not an enforced one.
